what.q: What is a nalog za plaćanje?
what.a: The single payment form used in Montenegro, a third of an A4 sheet. Its fields and layout are set by the Central Bank of Montenegro.

kinds.q: What is the difference between “Uplata” and “Prenos”?
kinds.a: “Uplata” is paying cash at a bank or post office counter, so the payer account stays empty. “Prenos” is paying from your account: you enter it, and ticking “Hitnost” sends the money as an instant transfer.

model18.q: How do I fill the reference for taxes?
model18.a: Public revenues use model 18. The credit reference is your PIB (8 digits) or JMB (13 digits), a dash and the 3-digit municipality code, e.g. 02088762-302 for Podgorica. The debit reference is the tax period.

model05.a: Model 05 is used by Customs, the Ministry of Interior and the Police. The Ministry's reference has 9 digits and is given at the counter.

iban.a: Not for payments within Montenegro: the order uses the 18-digit account, e.g. 510-12345-67. The IBAN (ME25 plus those 18 digits) is for payments from abroad.

qr.q: Why is there no QR code?
qr.a: Montenegro has no official payment QR standard yet. We'll add it once the Central Bank publishes one.

privacy.a: No. The order is built in your browser. Nothing is sent to a server, and the draft is kept only on your device.

batch.q: How do I print several orders at once?
batch.a: Fill in an order, click “Add to batch”, then change it for the next one. “Download PDF” in the batch makes one file with three orders per A4 page.

share.q: How do I send a filled order to someone?
share.a: Click “Share link”. The data sits in the link itself after the # sign, so it never passes through a server.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: How Uplatnica CG handles data: the order draft stays in your browser and nothing is sent to a server.
privacy.data: The payment order details (payee, account, amount, reference) stay in your browser. The draft, the print batch and the chosen language are kept only in localStorage on your device. The site sends none of it to a server and has no accounts or database. Clearing the site data in your browser deletes it.
privacy.analytics: Visits are counted with Plausible: no cookies, no personal data and no tracking across sites.
privacy.ads: The site shows ads through Google AdSense. Google and its partners may use cookies and similar technologies to show and measure ads. You manage consent through Google's consent message.
privacy.adsLink: How Google uses data from partner sites
privacy.donate: Donations go directly to the listed payment providers and bank. The site does not process them and keeps no data about donors.
